title: Actress Jennifer Winget shares video with William Ishmael
summary: Actress Jennifer Winget has shared a video introducing William Ishmael, referring to him as 'my man, my husband'. The video has led to speculation about a potential marriage. Ishmael is reportedly from Singapore.
summary_points: Actress Jennifer Winget shared a video introducing William Ishmael.
Winget referred to Ishmael as 'my man, my husband' in the video.
The video has sparked speculation about a possible marriage.
William Ishmael is reported to be from Singapore.
